platform_info.name: e2etest_multifile
platform_info.description: Test-only platform for the Playwright multi-file e2e suite: accepts multiple zip parts and reports which part each archive member came from. Excluded from release discovery; never deployed to participants.

description.en: This table lists every file found across the uploaded archive parts, together with which part it came from.
description.nl: Deze tabel bevat alle bestanden in de geüploade archiefdelen, inclusief het deel waar ze vandaan komen.

documentation.summary: Each row represents one file entry across the participant's uploaded archive parts, including which part it was found in.
documentation.source_file: the uploaded zip parts themselves (central directories)

columns.filename: Full path of the file inside the archive set.
columns.part_index: Position (0-based) of the uploaded part that owns this member, in canonical (name, size) order.

description.en: This table shows the first line actually read from each uploaded file's content, confirming data was read from every part.
description.nl: Deze tabel toont de eerste regel die daadwerkelijk is gelezen uit elk geüpload bestand, ter bevestiging dat er gegevens uit elk deel zijn gelezen.

documentation.summary: Each row shows the first line actually read from one archive member's content, proving the value came from the member's bytes and not just its name.
documentation.source_file: the uploaded zip parts themselves (member content, read on demand)

columns.filename: Full path of the file inside the archive set.
columns.part_index: Position (0-based) of the uploaded part that owns this member, in canonical (name, size) order.
columns.content_preview: The first line of the member's actual content, read via ArchiveSet.read_member.
